                limit = { main_rite = { has_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet_kehillah_hokhmah status = unknown } } }
                set_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet:tenet_kehillah_hokhmah status = known }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { main_rite = { has_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet_kehillah_messianic_hope status = unknown } } }
                set_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet:tenet_kehillah_messianic_hope status = known }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { main_rite = { has_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet_kehillah_prophetic_revelation status = unknown } } }
                set_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet:tenet_kehillah_prophetic_revelation status = known }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { main_rite = { has_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet_kehillah_temple_service status = unknown } } }
                set_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet:tenet_kehillah_temple_service status = known }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { main_rite = { has_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet_kehillah_covenant_community status = unknown } } }
                set_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet:tenet_kehillah_covenant_community status = permitted }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { main_rite = { has_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet_kehillah_avelei_tziyon status = unknown } } }
                set_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet:tenet_kehillah_avelei_tziyon status = permitted }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { main_rite = { has_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet_kehillah_scholarly_study status = unknown } } }
                set_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet:tenet_kehillah_scholarly_study status = permitted }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { main_rite = { has_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet_kehillah_sacred_liturgy status = unknown } } }
                set_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet:tenet_kehillah_sacred_liturgy status = permitted }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { main_rite = { has_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet_human_sacrifice status = unknown } } }
                set_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet:tenet_human_sacrifice status = prohibited }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { main_rite = { has_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet_ritual_cannibalism status = unknown } } }
                set_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet:tenet_ritual_cannibalism status = prohibited }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { main_rite = { has_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet_divine_marriage status = unknown } } }
                set_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet:tenet_divine_marriage status = prohibited }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { main_rite = { has_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet_gnosticism status = unknown } } }
                set_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet:tenet_gnosticism status = prohibited }
            }
        }
        religion:judaism_religion = { every_faith = { every_faith_rite = {
            if = { limit = { rite_has_tenet = tenet_kehillah_geonut }
                remove_rite_tenet = tenet_kehillah_geonut
                if = { limit = { NOT = { rite_has_tenet = tenet_religious_legal_pronouncements } } add_rite_tenet = tenet_religious_legal_pronouncements }
                else_if = { limit = { NOT = { rite_has_tenet = tenet_kehillah_scholarly_study } } add_rite_tenet = tenet_kehillah_scholarly_study }
                else_if = { limit = { NOT = { rite_has_tenet = tenet_kehillah_covenant_community } } add_rite_tenet = tenet_kehillah_covenant_community }
                else_if = { limit = { NOT = { rite_has_tenet = tenet_literalism } } add_rite_tenet = tenet_literalism }
                else_if = { limit = { NOT = { rite_has_tenet = tenet_adaptive } } add_rite_tenet = tenet_adaptive }
            }
        } } }
        religion:judaism_religion = { every_faith = { every_faith_rite = {
            if = { limit = { rite_has_tenet = tenet_kehillah_pilpul }
                remove_rite_tenet = tenet_kehillah_pilpul
                if = { limit = { NOT = { rite_has_tenet = tenet_kehillah_scholarly_study } } add_rite_tenet = tenet_kehillah_scholarly_study }
                else_if = { limit = { NOT = { rite_has_tenet = tenet_kehillah_covenant_community } } add_rite_tenet = tenet_kehillah_covenant_community }
                else_if = { limit = { NOT = { rite_has_tenet = tenet_literalism } } add_rite_tenet = tenet_literalism }
                else_if = { limit = { NOT = { rite_has_tenet = tenet_adaptive } } add_rite_tenet = tenet_adaptive }
            }
        } } }
        religion:judaism_religion = { every_faith = { every_faith_rite = {
            if = { limit = { rite_has_tenet = tenet_kehillah_minhag_avoteinu }
                remove_rite_tenet = tenet_kehillah_minhag_avoteinu
                if = { limit = { NOT = { rite_has_tenet = tenet_kehillah_covenant_community } } add_rite_tenet = tenet_kehillah_covenant_community }
                else_if = { limit = { NOT = { rite_has_tenet = tenet_kehillah_scholarly_study } } add_rite_tenet = tenet_kehillah_scholarly_study }
                else_if = { limit = { NOT = { rite_has_tenet = tenet_literalism } } add_rite_tenet = tenet_literalism }
                else_if = { limit = { NOT = { rite_has_tenet = tenet_adaptive } } add_rite_tenet = tenet_adaptive }
            }
        } } }
        religion:judaism_religion = {
            every_faith = {
                kehillah_sefer_quiet_rite_messages_effect = yes
                if = {
                    limit = { main_rite = { has_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet_kehillah_covenant_community status = unknown } } }
                    set_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet:tenet_kehillah_covenant_community status = permitted }
                }
                every_faith_rite = {
                    if = {
                        limit = { rite_has_tenet = tenet_communal_identity }
                        remove_rite_tenet = tenet_communal_identity
                        if = {
                            limit = { NOT = { rite_has_tenet = tenet_kehillah_covenant_community } }
                            add_rite_tenet = tenet_kehillah_covenant_community
                        }
                        else_if = {
                            limit = { NOT = { rite_has_tenet = tenet_adaptive } }
                            add_rite_tenet = tenet_adaptive
                        }
                        else = { add_rite_tenet = tenet_literalism }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { this = rite:samaritan rite_has_tenet = tenet_kehillah_covenant_community rite_has_tenet = tenet_literalism rite_has_tenet = tenet_ritual_celebrations }
                        remove_rite_tenet = tenet_ritual_celebrations
                        add_rite_tenet = tenet_kehillah_temple_service
                    }
                    # Replace only the previous exact Ashkenaz default.
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            this = rite:minhag_ashkenaz
                            rite_has_tenet = tenet_asceticism
                            rite_has_tenet = tenet_legalism
                            rite_has_tenet = tenet_kehillah_covenant_community
                        }
                        remove_rite_tenet = tenet_legalism
                        add_rite_tenet = tenet_kehillah_scholarly_study
                    }
                    kehillah_standing_refresh_ceilings_rite_effect = yes
                }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { NOR = { has_global_variable = kehillah_tenet_polish_20261115 has_global_variable = kehillah_tenet_polish_20261115_study } }
            religion:judaism_religion = { every_faith = {
                kehillah_sefer_quiet_rite_messages_effect = yes
                set_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet:tenet_communal_identity status = unknown }
                set_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet:tenet_gnosticism status = prohibited }
            } }
        }
        every_living_character = {
            if = {
                limit = { is_jewish_character_trigger = yes }
                kehillah_faith_revision_personal_effect = yes
                if = {
                    limit = { has_personal_tenet = tenet_communal_identity }
                    remove_personal_tenet = tenet_communal_identity
                    if = {
                        limit = { NOT = { has_personal_tenet = tenet_kehillah_covenant_community } }
                        force_set_personal_tenet = tenet_kehillah_covenant_community
                    }
                }
                remove_variable = kehillah_tenet_familiarity_faith
                kehillah_tenet_starting_familiarity_effect = yes
            }
        }
    }
}

# Character scope. Learning that a teaching exists does not endorse it.
kehillah_tenet_starting_familiarity_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            is_playable_character = yes
            is_jewish_character_trigger = yes
            NOT = { var:kehillah_tenet_familiarity_faith ?= faith }
        }
        set_variable = { name = kehillah_tenet_familiarity_faith value = faith }
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = { knows_tenet = tenet_adaptive }
                OR = {
                    rite = { NOT = { has_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet_adaptive status = unknown } } }
                    faith.main_rite = { rite_has_tenet = tenet_adaptive }
                }
            }
            add_known_tenet = tenet_adaptive
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = { knows_tenet = tenet_aniconism }
                OR = {
                    rite = { NOT = { has_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet_aniconism status = unknown } } }
                    faith.main_rite = { rite_has_tenet = tenet_aniconism }
                }
            }
            add_known_tenet = tenet_aniconism
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = { knows_tenet = tenet_asceticism }
                OR = {
                    rite = { NOT = { has_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet_asceticism status = unknown } } }
                    faith.main_rite = { rite_has_tenet = tenet_asceticism }
                }
            }
            add_known_tenet = tenet_asceticism
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = { knows_tenet = tenet_divine_marriage }
                OR = {
                    rite = { NOT = { has_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet_divine_marriage status = unknown } } }
                    faith.main_rite = { rite_has_tenet = tenet_divine_marriage }
                }
            }
            add_known_tenet = tenet_divine_marriage
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = { knows_tenet = tenet_eastern_syncretism }
                OR = {
                    rite = { NOT = { has_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet_eastern_syncretism status = unknown } } }
                    faith.main_rite = { rite_has_tenet = tenet_eastern_syncretism }
                }
            }
            add_known_tenet = tenet_eastern_syncretism
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = { knows_tenet = tenet_esotericism }
                OR = {
                    rite = { NOT = { has_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet_esotericism status = unknown } } }
                    faith.main_rite = { rite_has_tenet = tenet_esotericism }
                }
            }
            add_known_tenet = tenet_esotericism
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = { knows_tenet = tenet_gnosticism }
                OR = {
                    rite = { NOT = { has_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet_gnosticism status = unknown } } }
                    faith.main_rite = { rite_has_tenet = tenet_gnosticism }
                }
            }
            add_known_tenet = tenet_gnosticism
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = { knows_tenet = tenet_human_sacrifice }
                OR = {
                    rite = { NOT = { has_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet_human_sacrifice status = unknown } } }
                    faith.main_rite = { rite_has_tenet = tenet_human_sacrifice }
                }
            }
            add_known_tenet = tenet_human_sacrifice
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = { knows_tenet = tenet_inner_journey }
                OR = {
                    rite = { NOT = { has_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet_inner_journey status = unknown } } }
                    faith.main_rite = { rite_has_tenet = tenet_inner_journey }
                }
            }
            add_known_tenet = tenet_inner_journey
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = { knows_tenet = tenet_kehillah_avelei_tziyon }
                OR = {
                    rite = { NOT = { has_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet_kehillah_avelei_tziyon status = unknown } } }
                    faith.main_rite = { rite_has_tenet = tenet_kehillah_avelei_tziyon }
                }
            }
            add_known_tenet = tenet_kehillah_avelei_tziyon
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = { knows_tenet = tenet_kehillah_covenant_community }
                OR = {
                    rite = { NOT = { has_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet_kehillah_covenant_community status = unknown } } }
                    faith.main_rite = { rite_has_tenet = tenet_kehillah_covenant_community }
                }
            }
            add_known_tenet = tenet_kehillah_covenant_community
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = { knows_tenet = tenet_kehillah_hokhmah }
                OR = {
                    rite = { NOT = { has_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet_kehillah_hokhmah status = unknown } } }
                    faith.main_rite = { rite_has_tenet = tenet_kehillah_hokhmah }
                }
            }
            add_known_tenet = tenet_kehillah_hokhmah
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = { knows_tenet = tenet_kehillah_messianic_hope }
                OR = {
                    rite = { NOT = { has_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet_kehillah_messianic_hope status = unknown } } }
                    faith.main_rite = { rite_has_tenet = tenet_kehillah_messianic_hope }
                }
            }
            add_known_tenet = tenet_kehillah_messianic_hope
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = { knows_tenet = tenet_kehillah_prophetic_revelation }
                OR = {
                    rite = { NOT = { has_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet_kehillah_prophetic_revelation status = unknown } } }
                    faith.main_rite = { rite_has_tenet = tenet_kehillah_prophetic_revelation }
                }
            }
            add_known_tenet = tenet_kehillah_prophetic_revelation
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = { knows_tenet = tenet_kehillah_sacred_liturgy }
                OR = {
                    rite = { NOT = { has_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet_kehillah_sacred_liturgy status = unknown } } }
                    faith.main_rite = { rite_has_tenet = tenet_kehillah_sacred_liturgy }
                }
            }
            add_known_tenet = tenet_kehillah_sacred_liturgy
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = { knows_tenet = tenet_kehillah_scholarly_study }
                OR = {
                    rite = { NOT = { has_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet_kehillah_scholarly_study status = unknown } } }
                    faith.main_rite = { rite_has_tenet = tenet_kehillah_scholarly_study }
                }
            }
            add_known_tenet = tenet_kehillah_scholarly_study
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = { knows_tenet = tenet_kehillah_temple_service }
                OR = {
                    rite = { NOT = { has_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet_kehillah_temple_service status = unknown } } }
                    faith.main_rite = { rite_has_tenet = tenet_kehillah_temple_service }
                }
            }
            add_known_tenet = tenet_kehillah_temple_service
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = { knows_tenet = tenet_legalism }
                OR = {
                    rite = { NOT = { has_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet_legalism status = unknown } } }
                    faith.main_rite = { rite_has_tenet = tenet_legalism }
                }
            }
            add_known_tenet = tenet_legalism
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = { knows_tenet = tenet_literalism }
                OR = {
                    rite = { NOT = { has_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet_literalism status = unknown } } }
                    faith.main_rite = { rite_has_tenet = tenet_literalism }
                }
            }
            add_known_tenet = tenet_literalism
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = { knows_tenet = tenet_pursuit_of_knowledge }
                OR = {
                    rite = { NOT = { has_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet_pursuit_of_knowledge status = unknown } } }
                    faith.main_rite = { rite_has_tenet = tenet_pursuit_of_knowledge }
                }
            }
            add_known_tenet = tenet_pursuit_of_knowledge
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = { knows_tenet = tenet_religious_legal_pronouncements }
                OR = {
                    rite = { NOT = { has_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet_religious_legal_pronouncements status = unknown } } }
                    faith.main_rite = { rite_has_tenet = tenet_religious_legal_pronouncements }
                }
            }
            add_known_tenet = tenet_religious_legal_pronouncements
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = { knows_tenet = tenet_ritual_cannibalism }
                OR = {
                    rite = { NOT = { has_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet_ritual_cannibalism status = unknown } } }
                    faith.main_rite = { rite_has_tenet = tenet_ritual_cannibalism }
                }
            }
            add_known_tenet = tenet_ritual_cannibalism
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = { knows_tenet = tenet_ritual_celebrations }
                OR = {
                    rite = { NOT = { has_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet_ritual_celebrations status = unknown } } }
                    faith.main_rite = { rite_has_tenet = tenet_ritual_celebrations }
                }
            }
            add_known_tenet = tenet_ritual_celebrations
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = { knows_tenet = tenet_unrelenting_faith }
                OR = {
                    rite = { NOT = { has_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet_unrelenting_faith status = unknown } } }
                    faith.main_rite = { rite_has_tenet = tenet_unrelenting_faith }
                }
            }
            add_known_tenet = tenet_unrelenting_faith
        }
    }
}
